quote: In this paper, we have shown how noncanonical tokenizations expose a serious vulnerability in LLM alignment for safety. Adversarial tokenization is able to access the out-of-distribution regions of alignment but remain close enough to the data distribution of the pre-trained LLM, allowing them to evade alignment and elicit unsafe behavior from models...
